program.section_heading: ASSOCIATE IN SCIENCE IN PHYSICS FOR UC TRANSFER DEGREE (Major #C.3665.UCTP)
outcomes: Apply the Laws of Physics, physical concepts, and mathematical knowledge to solve problems in physics.
Demonstrate skill in scientific communication (both written and oral) by describing the results of laboratory experiments, and by providing other technical information, in a clear and concise manner.
Use experimental techniques in the laboratory to obtain accurate and precise data, to validate scientific theories, and to evaluate and properly use scientific instruments.
Prepare students for seamless transfer to a UC as a Physics major, or in a related field.
Provide students with a core body of knowledge for understanding physics.
Prepare students for advanced studies in the field of physics.
